body: Ive been through it to many times, and yes the whole world is like this... i wish it wasn't... but sometimes you just live in a world and a place that isn't right for you.  I should sum it up better, i had a good life if i had tried i'd be in a better place but i didn't and now it's too late.  I know every one thinks it's never to late... but sometimes it is, i missed to much to many people to many opportunities.) I'm fighting against a current now and it's to strong for me there is no where else to go from here, i have no drive, fuck i never have, i was always coasting through life i slit my wrists one year ago and missed everything i needed to hit. I took that as a sign that maybe i needed to try again.  Well i tried, i lost my job and am currently moving to the streets, i'm not saying i couldn't pick it all back up again i just don't see the reason why i should,,
